title: Time picker
summary: Chooses a time of day from a list at a fixed step, for schedule blocks and reminders. For bookable appointment slots use the TimeSlots pattern.

demos.title: Default
demos.note: A list of times every 30 minutes. The value is a 24-hour string such as 09:30, whatever the display format.

demos.title: Limits and step
demos.note: min and max set the first and last time on offer. step is the minutes between options.

c.text: Fasting draws run 7:00 to 11:00 AM, every 15 minutes.

demos.title: Locale
demos.note: The locale decides between 2:00 PM and 14:00. Both fields here share one value.
